dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-visibility white terminal fringes on the greater and median coverts form distinct, thin rows with high grayscale contrast against the dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Extremely prominent and sharp white edges on the outer webs of the folded tertials, creating a high-contrast boundary with the dark-colored feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible and distinct linear boundary where the uniform buff-colored crown and nape transition into the dark-centered, white-fringed feathers of the mantle.
